Her career high ranking is world No. 4, achieved on 31 January 2011.  To date, Schiavone is the last one handed-backhand player to win a Grand Slam title on the women's tour.

Olga Morozova: Olga Vasilyevna Morozova (Russian: Ольга Васильевна Морозова ) (born 22 February 1949) is a retired female tennis player who competed for the Soviet Union.  She was the runner up in singles at the 1974 French Open and 1974 Wimbledon Championships.
